details.s: Lúthien, also known as Tinúviel, was the immortal princess of Doriath, wife of Beren Erchamion, and the most beautiful of all the Children of Ilúvatar to ever live. Her love of the mortal man Beren, for whom she was prepared to risk everything, including her life, was legendary and lamented forever in song and story. She and Beren braved Morgoth's horrors, eventually winning a Silmaril from his crown and the approval of their marriage by King Thingol.
f: Princess of Doriath, Lady of Tol Galen
